register.labelZh: CHEAT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cheat on somebody 可以表示某人對丈夫、妻子或伴侶不忠。；cheat on something 可以表示某人、公司或機構故意不履行承諾、協議或責任。；cheat somebody out of something 可以描述商人、公司或不誠實的人欺騙別人，並騙走其金錢或財物。；這些 CHEAT 表達常見於關於感情關係、違背承諾、不誠實銷售和金錢的故事。
register.summaryEn: Cheat on somebody lets you explain that a person has been unfaithful to their husband, wife or partner. Cheat on something can show that a person, company or organisation has deliberately failed to honour a promise, agreement or commitment. Cheat somebody out of something can describe a seller, business or dishonest person tricking someone and taking their money or property. These CHEAT expressions often appear in stories about relationships, broken promises, dishonest sales and money.
